text: I. Professional Overview：Food science and engineering is an interdisciplinary subject based on chemistry, biology and engineering, focusing on the full chain research of food from raw materials to finished products. Its core includes the nutritional and health mechanisms of food, the optimization of processing techniques, quality and safety control, storage and preservation technologies, and the design of production equipment. It aims to solve problems such as technological innovation, engineering practice, and food safety in the food industry, and serves as a key bridge connecting basic science and industrial production.Ii. Training Objectives：Cultivate compound talents with a solid foundation in natural science, systematic professional knowledge and practical ability in food. Students are required to master skills such as food research and development, production management, quality inspection, and engineering design, possess innovative thinking and an international perspective, and be capable of engaging in scientific research, product development, process design, safety inspection, supply chain management, and industry supervision in fields such as food processing, circulation, and supervision, serving the upgrading demands of the food industry under the "Healthy China" strategy.
